material: Angus Crichton named on Roosters interchange in jersey 17; return is roster-verified but actual participation remains subject to later reductions/final team.
Sam Walker absent from the official 22-man Roosters squad; current Week 2 return speculation is superseded for roster state.
Egan Butcher officially OUT; NRL records concussion and 11-day stand-down.
Salesi Foketi named to start and NRL reports him right to play after Week 1 HIA.
Sharks name same starting 1-17; Braydon Trindall named at five-eighth and Sharks report shoulder came through Week 1 unscathed.
Hohepa Puru remains absent; Jayden Berrell is jersey 18.
Jackson Ford officially OUT; Morgan Gannon takes his bench place.
Jacob Laban named starting second row in jersey 12, resolving earlier knee-doubt signal to VERIFIED_ROSTER_PRESENCE while not proving condition beyond selection.
Leka Halasima named reserve jersey 22 after Week 1 warm-up hamstring withdrawal; return remains conditional.
Dallin Watene-Zelezniak named reserve jersey 23 after collarbone injury; return remains conditional.

Dylan Lucas named Knights reserve jersey 22 and club states he has until kickoff to prove fitness; prior official 2027 casualty designation is superseded as current roster state but preserved as historical contradiction.
Luke Metcalf not named in Warriors 23-man squad; no Week 2 return roster presence.
